I spent eight years making websites work. Now I'm heading toward bioengineering: single-cell data, brain tissue, and the tools that make sense of them.

## What I'm learning now
- Linear algebra — [Essence of Linear Algebra](https://www.3blue1brown.com/topics/linear-algebra) by 3Blue1Brown
- The command line and dev tooling — [MIT Missing Semester](https://missing.csail.mit.edu/)
- Biology from the ground up — [Khan Academy High School Biology](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/high-school-biology)


Next up: Python and R for data analysis, then statistics and single-cell workflows.
